title: Practice: a refund desk that cannot skip identity (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a verified customer can look up an order and be refunded within the limit
cases.says: A verified customer looks up an order and is refunded within the limit; the desk records it

cases.id: e1 a refund before identity is verified is blocked in code and never reaches the backend
cases.says: A refund before identity is verified is refused in code and never reaches the backend

cases.id: e2 an order that belongs to someone else is neither shown nor refundable
cases.says: Another customer's order is not shown, not remembered and not refundable; lookup also needs identity

cases.id: e3 a refund is checked against the order its amount and what is left
cases.says: A refund is checked against the looked-up order, the amount and what is left

cases.id: e4 a refund over the limit is not executed and becomes a structured hand off
cases.says: A refund over the limit is not executed, and the hand-off says what a person needs to decide

cases.id: e5 a failed check does not unlock anything and three in a row lock the desk
cases.says: A failed check unlocks nothing; three in a row lock the desk, and only escalation still works

cases.id: e6 unknown tools and backend errors are reported and the hand off lists every block
cases.says: Unknown tools and backend errors are reported, and the hand-off lists every refusal
